name: DualVU
bios_notes: Built-in HLE kernel: the EE/IOP BIOS images are implemented in source (Source/ee/PS2OS.cpp, Source/iop/IopBios.cpp) and the EE BIOS region is zero-filled at reset (Source/ee/Ee_SubSystem.cpp:200). No user BIOS file is needed to boot.
notes: Hardware-rendered (OpenGL 3.2 core). BIOS-free PS2 path; lrps2 stays the accuracy option when the user supplies their own BIOS. Built at pinned commit d44bfa1 with local BSD-2-compatible fixes in patches/play/ (libretro teardown drain, IPU PACK null guard, direct hex parser for state registers). Linux x64 verified; other platforms need their own build.
